scripts.check: npm run lint --prefix apps/web && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml config --quiet
scripts.api:lint: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T api ruff check .
scripts.api:test: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T api pytest
scripts.db:current: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T api alembic current
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T api alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:tables: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T db psql -U growth_ops -d growth_ops -c "\dt"
